incidents.name: WECOStaking deposit accounting
incidents.notes: WECOStaking.deposit() returns more WECOIN to the depositor than it takes in, so the attacker looped 1-token deposits until the staking contract's WECOIN balance was drained.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xd672b766d66662f5c6fd798a999e1193a7945451 created 2023-08-11T20:33:33Z by 0xcc424d4af7add42bed4ae68e27a1547ee81173b1, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xf5f21746ff9351f16a42fa272d7707cc35760e4b; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
